exposure: Greulich and Pyle method of bone age assessment
Fishman's SMI method of bone age assessment
Demirjian's method of dental age assessment
Willem's method of dental age assessment
cohort: The study included 260 Lebanese orthodontic patients (124 males, 136 females) with a mean age of approximately 11.8 years, divided into four age groups each.
finding: Willem's method proved more suitable for dental age assessment in both genders, while the Greulich and Pyle method was accurate for skeletal age assessment in males and only one female group, overestimating age in other female groups.
cross-section timing: Data was collected on children with a mean age of 11.89 ± 1.38 years for males and 11.75 ± 1.58 years for females.
